Legacy Office, Outlook and OpenDocument fixtures are unchanged from Apache Tika 3.3.2, under Apache-2.0 (LICENSE), at https://github.com/apache/tika/tree/3.3.2/tika-parsers/tika-parsers-standard/tika-parsers-standard-modules. testWORD.doc, testEXCEL.xls, testPPT.ppt and test-outlook.msg come from tika-parser-microsoft-module; testOpenOffice2.odt and LibreOfficeCalc_ods_1.3.ods / LibreOfficeImpress_odp_1.3.odp from tika-parser-miscoffice-module, each under src/test/resources/test-documents. Other fixtures are ours.
